title: Pullback compatibility of restricted derived-Hom evaluation
statement: For a triangle $a:Y\!\prime\to Y$, $a\circ h=h\!\prime$ and $\phi:a^*F\to F\!\prime$, the constructed map $c$ of [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map] satisfies $R(a,\phi)(c_{h,F}(t))=c_{h\!\prime,F\!\prime}(A(a,\phi)(t))$ for every raw class $t$. Here $R(a,\phi)$ is exactly the restricted-cohomology map of [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology], and $A(a,\phi)$ is the five-factor raw pullback of [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison]. This assertion does not assume or assert that $c$ is invertible.

proof.text: Apply the derived evaluation square to G=h* free(U), G prime=h prime* free(U), and the inverse composition comparison e. Evaluate the homomorphism equality at the inverse-zero-comparison image of generator(h,U).

Replace transportZero of this element by the corresponding element for h prime using the generator pullback theorem. The five-factor pullbackHom is definitionally the raw pullback, and the two evaluations followed by shiftIso are definitionally the constructed comparison maps. This gives the required equality.
